description: Verifies the Terrell-Penrose optics: the backward aberration inverts the forward aberration for axis-aligned and oblique velocities, a ray intersects a moving sphere with a positive Doppler factor, and the apparent rotation angle satisfies sin(angle) = beta.

checks.label: the backward aberration restores a transverse direction for a boost along x
the backward aberration restores a diagonal direction for an oblique boost
a ray aimed at the retarded position of the sphere intersects it
the Doppler shift at the hit is positive
the apparent rotation angle satisfies sin(angle) = beta
